comment: Hand-transcribed expected cgi-download decisions from pinned cgi-io C and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: cgi-io main_download requires application/x-www-form-urlencoded then session.access(sid, cgi-io, download, read) AND file read of canonicalize_path(path).
Missing or empty sessionid after a valid content-type is HTTP 403, not 400.
Invalid content-type is HTTP 400 Invalid form data.
luci-mod-system-flash read grants cgi-io download and /dev/mtdblock[0-9]* file read. Unauthenticated does not.
A '../' path is canonicalized before the file ACL so it cannot ride an allowed glob prefix.
This oracle does not open/stat/sendfile. cgi-upload and cgi-exec are not this slice.
This slice does not rewrite policy/grants.json; artifacts live in cgi_download_decisions.json.

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no cgi-io download
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_download: session_access false -> 403 Download permission denied
do not invent an unauthenticated cgi-download grant
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_download: !fields[1] -> 403 Download permission denied
valid content-type with absent sessionid is not HTTP 400
cgi-io@31cb3c89 util.c postdecode: CONTENT_TYPE must start with application/x-www-form-urlencoded
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_download: !post -> 400 Invalid form data

cases.note: Fixture login luci-mod-system-flash is not a stock device login.
rule_refs: cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_download conjunctive cgi-io download read and file read

cases.note: Stock root list read '*' / list write '*'; not a violation.
rule_refs: openwrt@4e964251 package/system/rpcd/files/rpcd.config list read '*' list write '*'
luci-mod-system-flash still contributes cgi-io download to the root session
cgi-io download read is not enough without file read of the canonical path
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c canonicalizes path before file ACL so ../ cannot ride /dev/mtdblock[0-9]*
luci-mod-system-config grants luci.setPassword/setLocaltime, not cgi-io download
do not treat a luci exec-method grant as cgi-download
